summary: H2O America filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 6,500,000 Equity Units at $50 stated amount, raising $325M gross ($315.25M net) via Wells Fargo, J.P. Morgan, BofA and TD as joint book-runners, with a 975,000-unit over-allotment option. Each Corporate Unit pairs a purchase contract with a 1/20 interest in $1,000 principal of 5.300% Remarketable Senior Notes due 2031; 2.450% contract adjustment payments apply. Settlement is November 1, 2029, converting into shares based on a market-value formula bounded by $58.5686 and $68.8231. Common closed at $58.57 on October 29, 2026. Watch dilution and remarketing reset risk.
